# Gosquared

GoSquared provides real-time web analytics and customer engagement tools to help businesses understand and interact with their website visitors.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/gosquared/.

## Actions

- **Account Shared Users**: Retrieve all team members that have access to a given project.
- **Add Account Site**: Add a new site to the GoSquared account.
- **Add Shared User**: Add a new shared user to a project.
- **Archive Chat Conversation**: Archive a chat conversation.
- **Check API Token Validity and Scopes**: Check whether an API key is valid and retrieve its enabled scopes.
- **Create People SmartGroup**: Add a new Smart Group to a GoSquared project.
- **Delete person**: Delete a person profile and all associated data.
- **Export Smart Group Feed**: Export all pageview activity for a Smart Group to CSV.
- **Get Base Path Metrics**: Retrieve base path metrics over a time period.
- **Get Campaign Medium Metrics**: Retrieve UTM medium metrics over a time period.
- **Get current concurrent visitors**: Retrieve the number of concurrent visitors currently on your site.
- **Get Page Metrics**: Retrieve page-level metrics over a specified period.
- **Get People Event Types**: Retrieve event types ordered by tracked count.
- **Get People Property Types**: Retrieve all property types in People CRM.
- **Get Person**: Retrieve a specific person profile by ID.
- **Get Real-Time Online Visitors**: Retrieve a list of current online visitors.
- **Get Real-Time Overview**: Retrieve a summary of real-time data for the site.
- **Get Real-Time Popular Pages**: Retrieve the most popular pages currently being viewed on your site.
- **Get Real-Time Visitor Platforms**: Retrieve platforms used by online visitors sorted by visitor count.
- **Get specific chat message**: Retrieve a specific chat message.
- **Get Specific Visitor**: Retrieve information for a specific online visitor.
- **Get Time Series**: Retrieve visitor counts over time as data points.
- **GoSquared - Get Person Feed**: Retrieve a specific person's event feed in reverse chronological order.
- **GoSquared - People Devices**: Retrieve device information from People CRM.
- **Leave Chat Note**: Leave a note in a chat conversation.
- **List Account Sites**: List all projects/sites accessible to the authenticated account.
- **List People**: Search and filter People CRM profiles.
- **List People SmartGroups**: Retrieve all Smart Groups for a project.
- **Now Sources**: Retrieve the most influential traffic sources currently driving visitors to your site.
- **Remove shared user**: Remove a user from a GoSquared project.
- **Retrieve Aggregate Metrics**: Retrieve aggregate metrics for a specified period.
- **Retrieve Chat Conversation**: Retrieve a chat conversation by its ID.
- **Retrieve Chat Conversations**: Retrieve chat data for reporting purposes.
- **Retrieve Chat Feed**: Retrieve messages and events from a chat conversation.
- **Retrieve Chat Messages**: Retrieve a list of messages from a chat conversation.
- **Retrieve Event Counts**: Retrieve counts of event triggers over a specified time period.
- **Send Chat Message**: Send a message in a chat conversation.
- **Smart Group People**: Retrieve people in a specific Smart Group.
- **Track GoSquared Event**: Send custom events to GoSquared.
- **Track GoSquared Identify**: Identify users and associate them with specific properties in GoSquared.
- **Track GoSquared Transaction**: Track e-commerce transactions.
- **Track Pageview**: Track pageviews.
- **Unarchive Chat Conversation**: Unarchive a chat conversation.
